title: Crispy Beef Street Tacos
description: Authentic Mexican street-style tacos with spiced ground beef, fresh salsa, cotija cheese, and a squeeze of lime on warm corn tortillas.
instructions: Make pico de gallo: combine diced tomatoes, jalapeño, half the onion, cilantro, lime juice, and salt. Set aside.
Cook ground beef in a skillet over high heat until browned, breaking it up.
Add remaining onion and garlic. Cook 3 minutes.
Season with chili powder, cumin, paprika, oregano, salt, and pepper. Cook 2 more minutes.
Warm tortillas directly over a gas flame or in a dry skillet until slightly charred.
Double up tortillas, fill with beef mixture, pico de gallo, and cotija cheese.
Serve with lime wedges and extra cilantro.
author: Chef Carlos
